name: Wolverine (Weapon X)

abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): İyileşmeyi bloklayan veya iyi ikincil hasarı olan şampiyon kullan. Petrify ve iyileşme manipülasyonu işe yaramaz. Dövüşün çoğunda engellenemez ve durdurulamaz olur, buna dikkat.
signatureAbility:
Boundless Rage
Berserk Rage's Cooldown Duration decreases by [2 - 7] second(s).
Start each Fight with a Regeneration Buff granting up to [700.88 - 20,412.3] Health based on the number of Rage Charges Weapon X ended the last fight with, up to 25.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Immune to All types of Regeneration Rate Modification except due to Poison.
The Potency of all Bleed Effects is reduced by 50%

abilitySections.title: Rage - Passive
content: Weapon X gains a Rage Charge each time he's Struck, one of his Abilities fails to trigger due to Chance, or a Debuff is Purified off the Opponent.
Gaining Rage Charges as well as all of the Berserk Rage Effects are unaffected by Ability Accuracy Reduction.
At 25 Rage Charges Weapon X snaps and enters a Berserk Rage lasting until his Rage Counters reach 0.
Upon entering Berserk Rage Weapon X goes Unstoppable for 4 seconds.
As long as he's Berserk, and not Unstoppable, Weapon X's Rage falls off one at a time, falling off faster the longer he's been Berserk.
After Weapon X's Berserk Rage ends all of its associated effects immediately end, and Weapon X cannot gain Rage Charges for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Berserk Rage Effects - Passive
content: Weapon X gains the following bonuses while in Berserk Rage:
Gain +[10,462] Attack.
100% Chance when Struck to gain a Regeneration Passive healing 100% of the Hit Damage taken, over 5 seconds.
100% Chance when Struck to gain a Fury Passive granting +[15,693] Attack, for 5 seconds. Max: 1 Stack.
Immune to All Stun Effects.
All Attacks become Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Attack Missed or Evaded - Passive
content: Gain +2 Rage Charges.
100% chance to go Unstoppable for 1 seconds.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: 50% chance to cause a Bleed Debuff dealing [1,569.3] Direct Damage over 5 seconds. With 10+ Rage this ability's chance to trigger increases to 100%.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked
content: While not in a Berserk Rage 50% Chance when Struck to gain a Regeneration Passive healing 40% of the Hit Damage taken, over 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: When Charging a Heavy Attack
content: If Weapon X has any Rage Charges he gains a Passive Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds, then going on Cooldown for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: If below 10 Rage Charges double current Rage Charges.
Refresh all Bleed Effects on Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Gain +5 Rage Charges.
If at or above 15 Rage Charges, go Berserk.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: While Berserk gain +[5,231] Attack.
100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [10,462] Direct Damage over 5 seconds.
If this attack doesn't Hit gain +5 Rage Charges.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: While Berserk each Hit pauses Rage fall off for 1 second(s).
If triggered while not Berserk gain up to +[7,846.5] Attack based on Rage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain Rage Charges up to 25 and then go Berserk.
100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [10,462] Direct Damage over 15 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Boundless Rage
content: Berserk Rage's Cooldown Duration decreases by [2 - 7] second(s).
Start each Fight with a Regeneration Buff granting up to [700.88 - 20,412.3] Health based on the number of Rage Charges Weapon X ended the last fight with, up to 25.
